title: Rumba Catalana
tagline: Barcelona-born rumba with a handclap pulse, rhythmic guitar, and lively vocals.
summary: Rumba catalana developed in Barcelona's Romani communities through a meeting of Cuban rumba, flamenco, and local popular music. Its rhythmic guitar strumming, handclaps, and buoyant vocals give it a distinctive dance feel. Artists have carried the sound from neighborhood gatherings into recordings and international performances.

pillars.name: Peret
pillars.why: Peret is widely recognized as a foundational figure in the development and popularization of rumba catalana.

pillars.name: El Pescaílla
pillars.why: El Pescaílla helped develop the guitar style and repertoire associated with Barcelona's rumba tradition.

pillars.name: Chacho
pillars.why: Chacho was an early rumba catalana performer whose recordings helped establish the genre's popular sound.
